name: Optimism
overview: Scripture teaches that true optimism is rooted in the confident assurance of God's presence and sovereign care. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, not fearing because the Lord is with them wherever they go (Joshua 1:9). This hope is grounded in God's love demonstrated through Christ, granting everlasting life to those who believe (John 3:16), and the peace Jesus imparts that surpasses worldly understanding (John 14:27). By guarding our hearts and trusting that all things work together for good for those who love God (Proverbs 4:23; Romans 8:28), Christians can rejoice daily in the gift of life the Lord has made (Psalms 118:24).
